findings: non-blocking: nova/frame/multipoint.py:132 build() docstring says an absent label resolves to "the first index entry whose name shares the label's leading prefix", but lines 146-147 key the dictionary by prefix and then look up the whole label (prefix.get(value, 0)), so a multi-token label such as coil_0_9 can never match a prefix key and always resolves to row 0; the behaviour matches the base revision, but the text describes a resolution the code does not implement.
